jobs.title: Design Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: About EH Group Engineering EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking Mechanical Engineers to design components and assemblies for our compact, high power density fuel cell products. This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate. jobs.title: Performance Creative Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du denkst in Hooks, Angles und Testing-Loops und willst sehen, was deine Ideen im Ad Account bewegen? Wir sind GORNATION - eine Sportmarke aus Münster, gegründet 2015 mit der Mission, Calisthenics weltweit zu stärken. Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt - von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Paid Ads sind unser Hebel für Skalierung. Auf Instagram erreichen wir bereits über 270.000 Menschen, und mit starken Creatives auf Meta und Google wollen wir noch mehr Menschen für Calisthenics und GORNATION begeistern. Wir suchen einen Performance Creative Manager , der unsere Ad Production von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung steuert. Du entwickelst Konzepte, planst Shootings, briefst unsere Cutter und sorgst dafür, dass regelmäßig neue Ads live gehen. Dein Ziel: mehr Ad Output in besserer Qualität, mehr Winning Concepts und Creatives, mit denen wir unseren Ad Spend skalieren können. Arbeitsmodell: ab 30 Stunden/Woche, vor Ort in Münster - weil Konzeption, Shootings und schnelles Feedback im Team live noch besser funktionieren. Start: 01.01.2027 Aufgaben Ad Production steuern: Du planst den Produktionsfunnel für Evergreen Ads und Aktionen und sorgst für einen konstanten Output an neuen Creatives. Konzepte entwickeln: Du recherchierst Trends, Formate und Ad Libraries und entwickelst daraus Konzepte, Hooks und Angles für Meta und Google. Shootings & UGC organisieren: Du planst und begleitest interne Ad Shootings und stimmst dich mit unseren Athleten zu Organic Reposts und UGC ab. Feedback-Loops mit Cuttern: Du briefst unsere Cutter, gibst Feedback zu Ad-Versionen und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst. Performance auswerten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Media Buyer analysierst du die Ergebnisse, leitest Learnings ab und bringst sie direkt in die nächsten Konzepte ein. Aktionen begleiten: Bei allen Kampagnen mit Paid-Anteil bist du von Anfang an dabei und planst die passenden Creatives rechtzeitig. Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Ad-Konzeption: Du hast bereits Ads konzipier

jobs.title: Senior Motion Designer
jobs.description: About Us Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses. We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more. We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide. About the Role We’re hiring a Motion Designer to join the Fieldguide team. You’ll own the animations, product explainers, and campaign pieces that bring our product and brand to life. You'll take dense, technical product and brand concepts and turn them into visual stories that are sharp, credible, and engaging. This is a dedicated motion design seat: you'll partner closely with our creative team to set the standard for motion and animation at Fieldguide, and build the visual language for how we represent our product and its ideas in motion.

Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins. On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions. On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers. Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most. jobs.description: Jouw impact bij Movares Bouw mee aan een duurzame leefomgeving, met het landschap als stevig fundament voor wonen, werken en recreëren. Dit ga je doen bij Movares Je maakt analyses, schetsen en visualisaties van landschappelijke projecten; Je werkt mee aan ontwerpen voor straten, bouwblokken, woonwijken en openbare ruimte; Je helpt bij visies voor gebieden waar wonen, werken en leven samenkomen; Je werkt kaarten, rapportages en presentaties helder en zorgvuldig uit; Je vertaalt ideeën naar beelden die collega’s en opdrachtgevers verder helpen. In deze meewerkstage draag je bij aan projecten die de leefomgeving beter maken. Je werkt vanuit onze hub in ’s-Hertogenbosch samen met ontwerpers en adviseurs aan doordachte oplossingen voor stedelijke en landschappelijke vragen. Daarbij krijg je ruimte om jouw creativiteit, ruimtelijk inzicht en ontwerpvaardigheden in te zetten in integrale projecten. Van het ontwerpen van straten, bouwblokken en woonwijken tot het opstellen van grootschalige (gebieds)visies: jouw bijdrage maakt het verschil. Dit ben jij bij Movares Voor deze vacature breng jij mee: Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van landschapsarchitectuur. Je zoekt een meewerkstage van minimaal 15 weken. Je hebt kennis van Adobe programma’s, AutoCAD en Sketchup We zijn benieuwd naar wat je maakt, ontwerpt en bedenkt. Daarom ontvangen we graag een portfolio bij je sollicitatie. Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomen we namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar verbinden met anderen voorop staat. jobs.description: Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.
